Population of legislative districts by Region, Province, and selected Highly Urbanized/Component City : 2015 |publisher=[[Philippine Statistics Authority]] |accessdate=April 18, 2020 |archive-date=April 5, 2022 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20220405172113/http://rsso03.psa.gov.ph/sites/default/files/Philippines%20-%20Population%20of%20Legislative%20Districts%20by%20Region_Province_and%20Selected%20Highly%20Urbanized%20or%20Component%20City.xlsx |url-status=dead }} |electorate = 351,176 (2022){{cite web|url=https://comelec.gov.ph/?r=2022NLE/Statistics/2022RVVAVmcocfinal|title=Number and Turn-Out of Registered Voters and Voters Who Actually Voted by City/Municipality May 9, 2022 National and Local Elections|website=Commission on Elections|accessdate=January 23, 2023}} |area = {{convert|140.28|sqkm|sqmi|abbr=on}} |towns = {{Collapsible list | titlestyle = font-weight:normal;text-align:left;background-color:WhiteSmoke; | title = 3 [[Local government in the Philippines|LGU]]s | '''Cities''' | [[Cabuyao]] | '''Municipalities''' | [[Bay, Laguna|Bay]] | [[Los Baños, Laguna|Los Baños]] }} |year = 1907 |members_label = Representative |members = [[Ramil Hernandez]] |blank1_name = Political party |blank1_info = {{Color box|{{party color|Lakas–CMD}}|border=darkgray}} [[Lakas–CMD]] |blank2_name = Congressional bloc |blank2_info = }} '''Laguna's 2nd congressional district''' is one of the seven [[congressional districts of the Philippines]] in the province of [[Laguna (province)|Laguna]], formerly La Laguna. It has been represented in the [[House of Representatives of the Philippines]] since 1916 and earlier in the [[Philippine Assembly]] from 1907 to 1916.{{cite web |url=http://www.congress.gov.ph/legislators/?v=province |title=Roster of Philippine legislators |publisher=[[House of Representatives of the Philippines]] |accessdate=April 18, 2020 |archive-date=March 16, 2017 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20170316064243/http://congress.gov.ph/legislators/?v=province |url-status=dead }} The district consists of the city of [[Cabuyao]] and adjacent municipalities of [[Bay, Laguna|Bay]] and [[Los Baños, Laguna|Los Baños]]. It is currently represented in the [[20th Congress of the Philippines|20th Congress]] by [[Ramil Hernandez]] of the [[Lakas–CMD]].{{cite web|url=https://www.congress.gov.ph/members/ |title=House Members |publisher=[[House of Representatives of the Philippines]] |accessdate=February 12, 2023}} Prior to its second dissolution in 1972, the district encompassed the eastern Laguna municipalities of [[Cavinti]], [[Famy, Laguna|Famy]], [[Kalayaan, Laguna|Kalayaan]], [[Liliw]], [[Luisiana, Laguna|Luisiana]], [[Lumban, Laguna|Lumban]], [[Mabitac, Laguna|Mabitac]], [[Magdalena, Laguna|Magdalena]], [[Majayjay]], [[Nagcarlan, Laguna|Nagcarlan]], [[Paete]], [[Pagsanjan]], [[Pakil, Laguna|Pakil]], [[Pangil]], [[Rizal, Laguna|Rizal]], [[Santa Cruz, Laguna|Santa Cruz]] (the provincial capital), [[Santa Maria, Laguna|Santa Maria]], and [[Siniloan]]. Following the restoration of the Congress in 1987, it encompassed the southwestern Laguna municipalities of Bay, Cabuyao, [[Calamba, Laguna|Calamba]], and Los Baños, with the creation of two additional districts in Laguna.{{cite web|title=The 1987 Constitution of the Republic of the Philippines|url=https://www.chanrobles.com/ordinance.htm|publisher=Chan Robles Virtual Law Library|access-date=April 10, 2020}}{{cite web|url=https://www.officialgazette.gov.ph/constitutions/the-1987-constitution-of-the-republic-of-the-philippines/the-1987-constitution-of-the-republic-of-the-philippines-ordinance/|title=THE 1987 CONSTITUTION OF THE REPUBLIC OF THE PHILIPPINES – ORDINANCE|website=Official Gazette of the Republic of the Philippines|accessdate=August 18, 2023}} Calamba was later separated from the district to form its [[Calamba's at-large congressional district|own representation]] beginning in 2019;{{cite PH act |title=An Act Separating the City of Calamba From the Second Legislative District of the Province of Laguna to Constitute the Lone Legislative District of the City of Calamba|chamber=RA |number=11078|date=September 24, 2018|accessdate=November 4, 2023|url=https://lawphil.net/statutes/repacts/ra2018/ra_11078_2018.html/|publisher=The Lawphil Project - Arellano Law Foundation, Inc.}} however, it remained part of the 2nd ''[[Sangguniang Panlalawigan]]'' district until 2024 for the purpose of electing members of the [[Laguna Provincial Board]].{{cite news|url=https://opinyon.net/national/2-board-members-for-laguna-s-districts|title=2 board members for Laguna's districts|author=OpinYon News Team|website=OpinYon News|accessdate=October 17, 2024|date=August 19, 2024}} ==Representation history== {| class=wikitable |- ! rowspan="2" | # ! rowspan="2" colspan=2 | Image ! rowspan="2" | Member ! colspan=2 | Term of office ! rowspan="2" | Legislature ! rowspan="2" | Party ! rowspan="2" | Electoral history ! rowspan="2" | Constituent
